jobs.name: hermes-config daily push
jobs.prompt:
Daily snapshot: commit and push .hermes changes in tigor-ai to main (GitHub), Forgejo as fallback.

```bash
cd /home/nixos/tigor-ai
git status --short
git add .hermes/
git commit -m "auto: daily snapshot $(date +%Y-%m-%d)" --allow-empty-message

# Primary: push to GitHub main
git -c "credential.helper=!/home/nixos/tigor-ai/.hermes/scripts/git-credential-github" push github-pull-and-push-to-main main
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
  # Fallback: push to Forgejo
  . /opt/data/secrets/forgejo.conf
  git remote set-url forgejo-push-for-preview "http://${FORGEJO_USER}:${FORGEJO_PASS}@10.67.69.2:${FORGEJO_PORT}/hermes/tigor-ai.git"
  git push forgejo-push-for-preview main
fi
```

Report output of each command. If commit has no changes, that's fine — report it. If both pushes fail, report the error.
